_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Specialized Reusable Container Design Candidate List
summary: This Data Item Description specifies the content and format for submitting the Specialized Reusable Container Design Candidate List.
use_relationship: This Data Item Description (DID) specifies the content and format for submitting the Specialized Reusable Container Design Candidate List.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference document.
preparation_instructions.content:
The applicable issue of the document cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

MIL-STD-2073-1, Department of Defense Standard Practice for Military Packaging

(Copies of this document are available online at https://quicksearch.dla.mil.)

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Specialized Reusable Container Design Candidate List applies to new Depot Level Repairables (DLR) with unit costs in excess of $30,000 (USD) or a fragility factor of 50G or less. Additionally, the list applies to DLRs where the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) is currently utilizing their own OEM or other Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS) designed reusable container. Item Fragility Factor shall be as defined in MIL-STD-2073-1. The resulting list shall detail the part number, nomenclature, unit cost (USD) and quantitative fragility factor for each candidate item.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Contractor format is acceptable. The Specialized Reusable Container Design Candidate List shall be in a format compatible with the latest version of Microsoft Excel.
